name: college-event-management-system
description: College Event Management System - Full Stack Application

scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('client/dist')) { fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'public', { recursive: true }); }"
scripts.build:client: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('client/dist')) { fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'public', { recursive: true }); }"
